item.title: WeRead
item.description:
WeRead - WeRead Assistant

Call WeRead API through Agent API Gateway, providing search, bookshelf, notes, reviews and other capabilities.

Supported Capabilities

Capability Description User Example Details
Search Books Search in bookstore “Search for Three-Body” search.md
Book Info View book details, table of contents, reading progress “How many chapters?” “Where did I leave off?” book.md
Bookshelf View bookshelf “Show my bookshelf” shelf.md
Reading Statistics Reading duration, days, preference analysis “How long did I read this month?” readdata.md
Notes & Highlights View personal notes, underlines, bookmarks “Show my notes in Three-Body” notes.md
Popular Highlights View popular chapter highlights “Show popular highlights in this chapter” notes.md
Book Reviews View public reviews “What reviews are there for Three-Body?” review.md
Discover Personalized recommendations “Recommend some books” discover.md

Refer to corresponding documentation files for API parameters, response structure and workflows.
